title: Appointed as Assistant
original: File organization is one of my fortes! Uhh... What are these? Data charts and theory analyses...? Seems very complicated, unlike the romance novels I read. Doctor, have you read any Victorian literature? Just between the two of us, I share my name with the protagonist from my favorite work.

title: Talk 1
original: I used to believe the Infected would understand if I smiled at them, but I was wrong... Before I smile, I should put myself in their shoes to learn their pain, and that goes for all those who are oppressed.

title: Talk 2
original: Now that I've talked to Amiya and the Doctor, I can understand why she, an elite operator... and the rest of Rhodes Island made that choice.

title: Talk 3
original: It's a little embarrassing to say... but I really admire Bagpipe. It doesn't matter what she has been through, she takes pride in the fact she was once a Victorian soldier. Oh, please don't get the wrong idea. I still love Victoria, and it is this love that drove me to leave my homeland.

title: Talk after Promotion 1
original: It wasn't easy to lose the Dublinns. I talked to the girl called Reed afterwards, but it doesn't seem she remembers me. I suppose... that's a good thing for her. Should we get the chance, I would love to have a chat with her about poetry and novels. Oh, and it would be lovely if we became friends.

title: Talk after Promotion 2
original: I have every step of Trooping the Colour memorized by heart, but I still have a long way to go to truly carry the banner's weight and find the way forward.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
original: It takes a little time to care for my hair. I know merely keeping up appearances isn't enough, but I see this as part of living diligently. Doctor, your hair's kind of messy. Would you like me to fix it for you?

title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
original: If the day comes that you must face those countless fearsome enemies, I will stand by your side.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
original: Doctor... if we had met before that incident, I'm sure I would've found myself relying on your help. But I can't well wait forever for someone to tell me what righteousness is. At the very least, on this journey we walk together, I wish to be an ally you can count on.

title: Idle
original: Doctor, when I see you here like this, it reminds me of the days I spent lazing around in the Rhodes Island offices... the sunshine, the card games, and my friends... It really brings back memories.

title: Onboard
original: You must be Rhodes Island's commander? Operator Saileach, reporting in!

title: Watching Battle Record
original: Oh, could you stop for a moment, please? I would like to take notes.

title: Promotion 1
original: I was... disappointed in them. And so I threw away all the ribbons and medals I'd ever earned. But Rhodes Island is different. Thank you, Doctor. I accept this award.

title: Promotion 2
original: Even now, the blinding light that fended off the darkness still shines in my dreams, though I am still far, far away from her.

title: Added to Squad
original: May my banner protect all those who are innocent before my eyes.

title: Appointed as Squad Leader
original: My friends, as long as we stand together, there will be no evil we can't overcome!

title: Depart
original: Follow me. Forward!

title: Begin Operation
original: If battle is unavoidable, I will not allow my weaknesses to get in my way.

title: Selecting Operator 1
original: Phew... I'm ready.

title: Selecting Operator 2
original: Your orders, please.

title: Deployment 1
original: It's my duty to stand here.

title: Deployment 2
original: I will not back down.

title: In Battle 1
original: Can't you hear the children's cries?

title: In Battle 2
original: Can't you feel the cities crumbling away?

title: In Battle 3
original: You've never ever noticed the hideous grins of conspirators.

title: In Battle 4
original: Could you ever imagine… friends turning against each other, and homeland fading into nothing but memories?

title: 4-star Result
original: I simply want to defend the people's right to live, and it doesn't matter if they are Victorians or Infected.

title: 3-star Result
original: You showed me that even weeds struggling to grow in the ruins can stand tall. Thank you.

title: Sub 3-star Result
original: I can only hope they will come to understand their injustice.

title: Operation Failure
original: Doctor, this time, I'll stay. Hurry and take the others to safety.

title: Assigned to Facility
original: Phew... I reckon it won't be easy to slack off once I become an actual staff member here?

title: Tap
original: Eh? Oh, hello!

title: Trust Tap
original: Are you tired? I've baked some scones. Please, sit down, have some tea, and tell me what's on your mind.

title: Title
original: Arknights.

title: New Year's blessing
original: Here's some trifle, pudding, and carrot cake... Oh, is it too much? Sorry, I've been a little nervous for the whole morning. Before I knew it, I'd already made this much... Hehe, let's just say I made you all these desserts to thank you for everything you've done. I hope you can spend the year surrounded by sweetness.

title: Greeting
original: Hey, Doctor, you look cheerful as always!

title: Birthday
original: This Victorian poetry anthology is one I always used to read, back in County Hillock. Now, I'm giving it to you. Oh, there's one passage I really love—'Old Sunlight hugs tight all the town in her bosom. Old Moonlight bends down with a kiss to the wild.' The feeling you give me is, really, just as warm as that. Heheh, have a happy birthday, Doctor.

title: Anniversary Celebration
original: I may have left the military, but my honor and calling are things I won't lay aside. In future, I'll return to where my duty lies. Please, don't worry. The memories we've made, the ideals we've borne together at Rhodes Island, they will always be carved upon this ensign, to be forever by my side.
